publicLimitation: 官网可确认现馆由 Fritz Eller 改扩建并列出主要展览语义，官方正射影像可核验屋顶外廓；已检查的 DAM 清单只记录 1987 年 Stollwerk 方案档案，不能证明其对应 1993 年启用并持续改展的现馆。未找到可核验的现状室内正投影平面，因此本场馆不进入室内模型加载器。

sources.finding: The museum's official architecture page states that Fritz Eller renovated the listed customs office and designed the new construction begun in October 1992 and completed for the museum; it provides architectural history but no floor plan.

The official exhibition page verifies current visitor semantics including the 600-square-metre World Tour of Cocoa, tropical greenhouse, transparent factory, cultural-history exhibition and top-level finale; it does not publish orthographic room boundaries or level connections.
The official 2025 announcement explicitly places the new finale on the top exhibition level, confirming that exhibition distribution has changed; no level plan accompanies it.
Official NRW orthophoto verifies the glazed prow, historic block and curved entrance-wing roof footprints only.

The official Deutsches Architekturmuseum inventory, printed page 118, lists archive records 028-219-000 through 028-219-011 for a 1987 Stollwerk Schokoladen Museum proposal, including site plans, ground/upper-floor plans and sections. The inventory does not reproduce the drawings or establish that this unbuilt or superseded proposal matches the current Fritz Eller museum.
